source_reference: Codex built-in image generation (edit/reference mode), session 01a12cf0-6478-7731-aa2a-ce12cb405970, archived afterwards. References: the approved Look 2 style-test board, title art B (mood and palette only), the palette card and the approved junction-hatch.png prop in this register (material and detail language only). Generation prompts, the per-attempt log (two attempts per output; the first closed attempt was rejected for a visible backdrop) and the review images are retained in ignored art notes.
rights_review_status: Provisional AI-generated gameplay prop. Not yet reviewed or approved by Nathanial Henniges: integrated on 2026-10-11 for his review, under his decision on the opening's staging (a maintenance hatch on the left, behind WOLF's cage). Final commercial asset-rights review remains open; not covered by the code/docs GPL license.
modifications: Original 1536x1024 RGBA image copied byte for byte from the tool's output (SHA-256 00ae3ff4591e389d...), keeping every PNG chunk the tool wrote: IHDR, caBX (its C2PA content credentials), IDAT and IEND. Its background is transparent apart from a faint generation halo (alpha 1 to 23) and its body is alpha 253-254; the game copies clear the halo and make the body opaque, this file keeps both.
implementation_status: Full-size original, kept for re-derivation and art edits. Not imported or exported by Godot (apps/game/art-source/.gdignore). The game uses the frame and leaf layers derived from it (entries opening-hatch-frame and opening-hatch-leaf).

modifications: One of three aligned 640x387 layers cut from the two originals on their shared canvas: the closed original with its opening cut out. Alpha below 24 cleared (the generation halo) and 248 or more made opaque; the opening is an anti-aliased chamfered rectangle (x 336-1204, y 314-727, 44 px corners) measured on the originals; cropped to the art's bbox plus 8 px (99..1437 x 108..918) and downscaled with Lanczos in premultiplied linear light; saved as an optimised PNG (SHA-256 cc318384169442e3...), which does not carry the originals' C2PA chunk. Reproducible byte for byte with the script; no other pixel edits. Imported with mipmaps and drawn with linear-with-mipmaps filtering, tinted (0.6, 0.66, 0.74), OpeningHatch.ROOM_TINT, to sit in the dark containment room.
implementation_status: In use since 2026-10-11. The front layer of the opening's maintenance hatch (OpeningHatch), its sill on the floor at x 128 behind WOLF's cage, 0.21x (about 134 px wide); its lamp's colour (red locked, green open) is drawn over the painted lens. Drawn over WOLF only while he slips into the duct. Shown only during the opening.
